settings.text: A few minutes of care keeps the smooth panels clean and the suede rich for years. These are the rituals we follow.

settings.heading: Before first wear
settings.row_content: Apply a suede protector spray to suede pairs and suede overlays from 20 cm away, and let it dry for 24 hours. Insert cedar shoe trees into leather pairs the evening you bring them home.

settings.heading: Smooth panels
settings.row_content: For the smooth upper of The Silent Grind and A Fresh Start. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after wear. Every few months, feed with a neutral cream and buff gently.

settings.heading: Suede
settings.row_content: For the suede toe, eyestay and collar of both models. Use a soft suede brush, always in one direction, to lift the nap. Lift marks with a suede eraser; never soak suede. A Fresh Start's sand suede benefits from a protector spray before first wear.

settings.heading: Midsoles & laces
settings.row_content: Clean the white cupsole with a damp cloth and a little mild soap; an eraser sponge lifts scuffs. Laces can be hand-washed and dried flat.

settings.heading: Storage
settings.row_content: Keep each pair in its dust bag with cedar shoe trees, away from direct sunlight and heat. Keep the workshop card with the box: it carries your pair's chapter.

settings.heading: Repairs & questions
settings.row_content: Write to us with your pair's serial (printed under the QR tag) and we will advise on care or repair.
